messages:
Samir Patel: @here quick heads up — scheduling a short routing reconciliation tonight in eu-west1 to trim stale routes and rebalance model traffic. Window: 2026-03-28 02:00–02:30 UTC. Expected impact: transient 1–3 minute latency spikes or occasional 5xx for a small subset of embedding/generation requests. We’ll run staggered hosts and warm the new routes; still flagging for ops attention.

incident-bot: Scheduled maintenance created: RDW-OPS-4662 — eu-west1 routing reconciliation. Escalation policy: oncall-eng -> eng-sre -> eng-platform. Pager enabled.

Maya Chen: Thanks Samir. Can you share the exact endpoints/services that might see errors? Need to prep statuspage copy + customer notify.

Samir Patel: primary hit surface: /v1/generate (larger seq lengths) and /v1/embeddings for some high-concurrency clients. Impact will be biased toward streaming sessions that cross a route boundary. Non-streaming short requests likely unaffected.

Jordan Lee: Will dedicated customers on Reserved pools be impacted? We promised isolation to them.

Samir Patel: Reserved pools should be unaffected 99% — routing reconciliation runs only on shared serving plane. If a customer is pinned to Dedicated, they’re fine. I'll add a note in the customer draft.

Priya Singh: Drafting customer-facing blurb now. Posting below for review — please edit for tone: 

```
Planned maintenance: routing reconciliation in eu-west1
Start: 2026-03-28 02:00 UTC
End: 2026-03-28 02:30 UTC (estimated)
Impact: You may experience brief increases in latency or short errors for in-flight requests to text-generation and embeddings endpoints. Most requests will be unaffected.
What we’re doing: We're rebalancing routing tables and warming caches to improve long-term latency and reduce future throttles.
What you should do: No action required. For critical workloads, consider retrying idempotent requests.
Contact: support@redwood.inference or visit status.redwood.ai for live updates.
```

Maya Chen: That reads fine. Add a line: "We do not expect any data loss or changes to model outputs." Also add: "Dedicated customers: no expected impact."

Priya Singh: updated. Adding suggested lines.

ops-bot: Runbook RDW-OPS-4662 linked: https://wiki.redwood/ops/rdw-ops-4662. Preflight checklist: 1) confirm canary routes 2) ensure fallback variant ready 3) alerting thresholds set.

Samir Patel: Canary routes are configured. Fallback variant is the quantized-1b model family (fast start). I've pre-seeded KV cache for top 5 tenants.

Jordan Lee: Important — please add a snippet for the incident page that engineers can paste into Statuspage. Minimal copy please.

Maya Chen: Draft Statuspage entry (copy/paste):

```
Scheduled Maintenance — Routing Reconciliation (eu-west1)
Start: 2026-03-28 02:00 UTC
End: 2026-03-28 02:30 UTC (estimated)
Impact: Some users may see short-lived increases in latency or transient errors for generation and embedding requests. We’re performing maintenance to rebalance routing and improve overall stability.
Updates: We will post start/completion notices and timely updates here.
```

Samir Patel: Pasting that into status.redwood.ai now. I'll also open a high-priority support ticket template for customers who report issues.

incident-bot: statuspage update posted (ID spg-9832).

Priya Singh: Customer email template (subject + body) below. Please sanity-check tone and escalation link.

Subject: Planned maintenance in eu-west1 — brief latency window

Body:
Hi <CustomerName>,

We are performing routine maintenance in eu-west1 on 2026-03-28 02:00–02:30 UTC that may cause brief latency increases or transient errors for some in-flight requests to generation and embeddings endpoints. We do not expect data loss.

If you have critical workloads scheduled during this window and need assistance, reply to this email or open a support case at <support link> and we will work with you to mitigate.

Thanks,
Redwood Platform Team

Maya Chen: Good. Add contact phone for enterprise customers and a note that Reserved/Dedicated customers unaffected.

Samir Patel: On-call plan: I’ll be primary at 01:45–03:15 UTC. @Maya you’re the backup 02:30–04:00. If pager fires, escalate to Jordan then Priya.

Jordan Lee: Got it. I’ll watch alerting dashboards (tail latency, 5xx rate) and stand by.

ops-bot: Pager rule check: alerts configured for 5xx rate >0.5% sustained 2m, tail P99 latency >500ms. Escalation delays: 2m -> oncall -> 5m -> eng-sre.

Samir Patel: Preflight checklist done. Running a final smoke two minutes before start.

Maya Chen: Quick nit: change the statuspage "impact" line to include "shortened retries are recommended for idempotent calls" — helps customers.

Samir Patel: Updated status copy accordingly.

Customer Success Bot: Notifying top 20 high-throughput customers via targeted DM with the draft email.

incident-bot: Pager test (non-escalating) scheduled at 2026-03-28 01:50 UTC.

Samir Patel: Starting the window — executing step 1 (drain low-priority routes). Will post progress updates here. :rotating_light: 

Samir Patel: Step 1 complete. Step 2: rotate route table on shard 3/6. Minimal in-flight losses seen so far.

Jordan Lee: Seeing a short P99 bump to 680ms around the rotate start; no meaningful 5xx spike. Looks within expected envelope.

Maya Chen: Noted. Update statuspage: "Maintenance in progress — we are seeing brief latency increases for some requests."

incident-bot: statuspage update posted (ID spg-9832-update-1).

Samir Patel: Step 3 finish — warm caches on rotated routes. Monitoring.

Jordan Lee: Tail latency trending down. No customer tickets yet.

Samir Patel: All route rotations complete. Running a final validation sweep.

Priya Singh: I just saw one support ticket from a customer with a streaming session interruption; replied with suggested retry guidance and opened an incident ticket for follow-up.

Maya Chen: Thanks. Samir, when you validated, please confirm in this thread so I can post completion and clear the statuspage.

Samir Patel: Validation done. No outstanding errors, P99 back to baseline. Marking maintenance complete. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: Status: maintenance_completed — RDW-OPS-4662.

Maya Chen: Posting final statuspage update and sending the customer completion email.

```
Completed — Routing Reconciliation (eu-west1)
Completed at: 2026-03-28 02:12 UTC
Impact: Brief increases in latency observed; a small number of in-flight streaming requests were interrupted and retried by clients. No data loss reported.
Follow-up: We will reach out to any customer who reported an issue.
```

Priya Singh: Completion email draft below for enterprise contacts. Please review quickly then I'll send.

Subject: Maintenance completed — eu-west1 routing reconciliation

Body:
Hi <CustomerName>,

Maintenance in eu-west1 completed at 2026-03-28 02:12 UTC. We observed brief latency spikes and a small number of interrupted streaming sessions. No data loss. If you experienced an issue, please reply to this message or open a support case and we will prioritize follow-up.

Thanks for your patience,
Redwood Platform Team

Jordan Lee: Nice and clear. No further action from infra side.

Samir Patel: Handoff: @Maya you formally take this incident for any outstanding customer follow-ups. I’m unaccounting myself from the pager at 03:15 UTC.

Maya Chen: Acknowledged, taking ownership for post-maint follow-up.

Customer Success Bot: Message sent to customers who had interrupted sessions with suggested remediation steps.

Samir Patel: Closing thread. Great coordination all.

Priya Singh: Adding a short postmortem note to RDW-OPS-4662: observed transient streaming interruptions for 3 tenants; follow-up action: refine warm-up to include session tokens for streaming.

Jordan Lee: +1 on follow-up. Will add alert tuning suggestion.

Maya Chen: Thanks team. :tada:
